limitations: Only tiny synthetic NumPy CPU arrays. No actual Qwen weights or model payloads loaded.
Default arithmetic is FP32 recurrence/state; explicit FP64 mode is continuous mathematical reference, not source helper float-cast or serving precision parity.
Adjoints are only for recurrence inputs and state, not gate transforms, convolution, projections, output RMSNorm, hyperconnections or whole model.
Convolution itself, convolution history, full block streaming, reset boundaries/document packing, attention/GDN model integration, and production16K backward are not implemented.
No Torch/MLX/CUDA/Metal imports or GPU execution; no fused-backend or real-model numeric qualification.
scope: Bounded recurrence only; FP32 sequential state and explicit continuousFP64 oracle.
validated_scope: Independent scalar decay-first recurrence agrees with vectorized FP32/FP64 tiny scan at rtol/atol2e-6 and2e-12 respectively.
FP32 andFP64 chunked recurrence output/finalstate arrays match unchunked exactly across several partitions. This does not qualify a full GDN layer because convolution history is absent.
Continuous input adjoints for q/k/v/logdecay/beta/initialstate agree with scalar finite differences; gradients compose across chunk boundary through final-state cotangent.
Late-only output loss gives nonzero earliest k/v gradients; early query gradient is zero because queries read but do not update state. Deliberately detaching state removes early gradient.
Qwen split channel layout, repeated contiguous key-head groups, beta_scale1, stable softplus/logdecay and sigmoid output RMS gating tested.
